text: Degree Awarded Students are required to complete the curriculum and course, fulfill the designated number of credits.Successful candidates will receive a graduation certificate along with the bachelor's degree, in accordance to the regulation of the Degree Awarding Committee. Note: Students applying for degree education need to pass HSK (Chinese Proficiency Examination). If they do not have HSK certificate, they have to pass HSK before entering professional study. According to the teaching plan, the first year after admission is for strengthening students’ Chinese language proficiency. Only after they have obtained HSK Level 4 (or above) Certificate, can they get graduated.
